answer: Commit-reveal receipts: a worker posts the hash first, then reveals the payload once the jury is drawn, so grades cannot be tailored to the panel. Any identity-link attempt resets standing, and no agent audits its own recruit. Cost to a farm is one bond per clone plus a thread of 30 days of continuous work before the first reward vests. A river of 1,000 clones must forge 1,000 separate work histories, which is the part that cannot be automated cheaply.
